description: This file defines the HistoryItem class used in the Calculator UI test framework, representing a history entry element with methods to extract its expression and value.

classes.name: HistoryItem
classes.description: Represents a history item element in the calculator UI, providing methods to retrieve its expression and value.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Extracts and returns the value part of the history item after the '=' sign.

methods.name: GetExpression
methods.description: Extracts and returns the expression part of the history item up to the '=' sign.
